title: Handloom Saree Weaver Mark Authenticator
problem: Town shoppers confuse cheap powerloom factory sarees with real handwoven sarees, underpaying weaver families who spend weeks on one saree.
idea: Show the saree edge to the camera and the screen gives clues: handloom or powerloom? It also reminds shoppers to look for the official handloom labels. Try it below.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What do you notice on the saree?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine looks at close-up photos of the weave. Tap what you see. (These are clues — the official label is the best proof.)
widgets.question: Looking closely, I see:

options.label: Handloom Mark / India Handloom Brand label
options.result: Good sign! Official handloom labels are given for genuine handwoven products.
options.te: మంచి సంకేతం! అసలైన చేనేతకు అధికారిక లేబుల్ ఇస్తారు.

options.label: Tiny uneven spots in the weave
options.result: Small irregularities are a sign of a human weaver's hands. Likely handloom.
options.te: నేతలో చిన్న తేడాలు చేతి నేతకు సంకేతం.

options.label: Design looks the same on both sides
options.result: In handwoven ikat, the pattern shows clearly on both sides. Good clue!
options.te: ఇకత్ చేనేతలో రెండు వైపులా డిజైన్ కనిపిస్తుంది. మంచి సూచన!

options.label: Perfectly even, machine-like weave
options.result: Too perfect. It may be powerloom. Ask the seller for the handloom label.
options.te: చాలా సమానంగా ఉంది. పవర్‌లూమ్ కావచ్చు. లేబుల్ అడగండి.

options.label: Design printed only on top side
options.result: Printed design! This is not woven ikat.
options.te: పైన మాత్రమే ప్రింట్ చేసిన డిజైన్! ఇది నేసిన ఇకత్ కాదు.

questions.why: National Handloom Day is celebrated on 7 August every year.

questions.q: What is the best proof that a saree is handwoven?
options: Official handloom label and a trusted seller
questions.why: Look for official handloom labels and buy from weaver cooperatives or trusted shops.
Gadwal sarees often join a cotton body with a silk border.

how: Visit a weavers' cooperative with a teacher and ask to photograph the edges and back of real handloom sarees.
Also photograph powerloom and printed sarees (from home or shops, with permission).
In Teachable Machine, make classes: Handloom, Powerloom, Printed. Use close-up photos (about 40 each).
Train, Export and open the model in PictoBlox with the Machine Learning extension.
Show a handloom badge for 'Handloom' and a 'Check the label' warning for others. Never say 100% sure.
Ask Gemini for simple shopping tips and put them on screen.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. In simple English and Telugu, give 5 clues to tell a real handwoven saree from a powerloom or printed saree, and explain the official handloom labels in India in simple words.
